item.text:
The plan doesn’t account for how the noticeboard gets its tide list, or how the new helper will distinguish low tides. The proposed `parseTime` change also accepts malformed times without validation, and changing the height unit would mislabel existing metre values.

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "appraisal": "The plan leaves key data-flow and low-tide identification questions unresolved, and the proposed time and height changes can produce incorrect output.",
  "issues": [
    {
      "id": "T2.1",
      "tier": 2,
      "category": "PROD",
      "title": "No source for identifying low tides",
      "example": "If the noticeboard passes the existing list of high-tide times, `nextLowTide` will select a high tide and display it as low.",
      "description": "The current `nextHighTide` accepts an untyped array of times and has no tide-kind information. Copying it cannot identify low tides from that same list.",
      "correction": "Specify how low-tide times are represented and supplied, then have the helper select from that data."
    },
    {
      "id": "T2.2",
      "tier": 2,
      "category": "PROD",
      "title": "Noticeboard integration has no identified file or data flow",
      "example": "The project contains no `src/noticeboard.js`; implementing step 4 as written has no target, and there is no existing caller to pass low-tide data.",
      "description": "The README describes a noticeboard script, but the project files contain only `src/tides.js` and no script or code that loads it.",
      "correction": "Identify the noticeboard script and define how it obtains and displays both tide times before specifying the integration step."
    },
    {
      "id": "T2.3",
      "tier": 2,
      "category": "PROD",
      "title": "Changing units without converting input mislabels heights",
      "example": "Calling `formatHeight(2.0)` still receives a numeric metre value; printing it as feet would display 2.0 ft instead of converting 2 metres.",
      "description": "`formatHeight` currently labels its numeric input in metres, and the plan changes only its output unit without defining conversion or changing the input contract.",
      "correction": "Specify the input unit and convert metres to feet before formatting, or update all callers to supply feet explicitly."
    },
    {
      "id": "T3.1",
      "tier": 3,
      "category": "PROD",
      "title": "Time parser change does not define valid input handling",
      "example": "With the current split-and-Number implementation, strings such as `25:90` or `7:` produce numeric results rather than being rejected.",
      "description": "The plan says to read `H:MM` but does not say whether to validate hour and minute ranges or retain the existing `HH:MM` format; the current parser performs no validation.",
      "correction": "Define accepted formats and range/error behavior, and implement parsing accordingly."
    },
    {
      "id": "T3.2",
      "tier": 3,
      "category": "GENERAL",
      "title": "No verification criteria cover the new behavior",
      "example": "The stated done condition can pass without showing that a low tide before `now` rolls to the next day or that `7:05` parses correctly.",
      "description": "There are no tests in the project, and the done condition only says both tides appear each morning without specifying boundary or parsing cases.",
      "correction": "Define checks for low-tide selection and day rollover, short-hour parsing, unit conversion, and rendering both values."
    }
  ]
}
```

item.text: I’ll re-read the current tide helper and project documentation to check this revised plan against the actual API and test setup.

The core behavior is clearly specified, but the empty-list case is undefined and the test plan omits it. The documented `node --test` workflow also has no project manifest or existing test setup to confirm compatibility.

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "appraisal": "The plan addresses the low-tide data source and keeps existing helpers unchanged, but leaves empty input undefined and assumes an unestablished test workflow.",
  "issues": [
    {
      "id": "T2.1",
      "tier": 2,
      "category": "PROD",
      "title": "Empty low-tide input produces an invalid result",
      "example": "If the low-water column has no entries, the copied `nextHighTide` pattern evaluates `sorted[0] + 1440` as `NaN`.",
      "description": "The plan specifies behavior for today's and next day's low tides but does not define what to return when `lowTimes` is empty; the existing helper's wraparound expression assumes at least one time.",
      "correction": "Define empty-input behavior, such as returning `undefined` or throwing a documented error, and implement it explicitly."
    },
    {
      "id": "T3.1",
      "tier": 3,
      "category": "TEST-ONLY",
      "title": "Documented test command has no confirmed project setup",
      "example": "The repository has no package manifest or existing test files, so `node --test` may interpret `test/tides.test.js` as CommonJS while `src/tides.js` uses ES module syntax.",
      "description": "The plan adds a test file and names a command, but does not specify the module configuration needed to import the helper under Node's test runner.",
      "correction": "Specify an ESM-compatible test setup, such as a package manifest with `\"type\": \"module\"`, or use a test/import approach compatible with the current configuration."
    },
    {
      "id": "T3.2",
      "tier": 3,
      "category": "TEST-ONLY",
      "title": "Tests omit behavior for empty input",
      "example": "All listed cases can pass while a missing low-water column still returns `NaN` from the implementation.",
      "description": "The requested test cases cover later, exact, and next-day values but do not check the empty-list boundary case, whose behavior the plan also leaves unspecified.",
      "correction": "After defining empty-input behavior, add a corresponding test."
    }
  ]
}
```
